notes: This table is the end-to-end store funnel: impressions to page views to first-time downloads (App Store), then trial starts, paid stock/proceeds, MRR, and churn (RevenueCat).
RevenueCat new customers are not installs and are not shown as the install step.
Paid conversions in the last 28 days are not a single RevenueCat count here; 28-day proceeds are $0 on all six apps, and paid subscription counts are stock.
Renewals are not a separate published number; churned actives and active subscriptions stand in for retention.
